workload: Name 150 GUIDs that hit the bundled tables and 400 that miss, as showinfo, to_dict and DEPEX parsing do across a full vendor BIOS.
notes: Each call does aguid() then list(table.items()) and a Python int-by-int scan. The six tables hold 2255 entries, so a miss builds thousands of short-lived tuples; 550 lookups allocate 1840561 objects (7 runs, full spread 0). A dict from the 16 raw bytes to the name, built once, returns the same string or None. tests/test_scripts.py GuidListTest drives get_guid_name through scripts/uefi_guids.py. Overlap: no open PRs. author:dexhunter has only #164, merged, which changes search_firmware_volumes; HEAD af70c1d then switches that same function to finditer. Also skipped from the last 30 days: NVARVariable.process (#158), FirmwareFile.dump and FirmwareFileSystem.build (#160), PaddingObject/is_erased/FlashRegion.process (#161), DellUpdateBinary (#162), FirmwareVolume.dump (#163), and the Nov 1 checksum, section-copy and decompressor edits. git log -L shows get_guid_name unchanged since 2026-10-16. Open issue #165 is a security-contact question, not a refactor.

workload: Format the GUID of 2500 firmware objects, one per file and section, the way iterate_objects() does when listing a DXE volume.
notes: guid_label calls sguid, which builds a struct format string, eight '%02x' pieces, a join and two slices on every object (83297 allocations for 2500 GUIDs, 7 runs, full spread 0). One cached Struct and one format string produce the same text. tests/test_termination.py NestingTest.test_many_concatenated_volumes calls iterate_objects, which calls info(), which reads guid_label. The function is unchanged since 2026-10-16. Recent utils.py edits are search_firmware_volumes only (#164 and af70c1d); this property was not part of them. Same skipped set as the GUID-name entry (no open PRs, dexhunter only #164, #158-#163 and the Nov 1 parser/checksum/decompressor commits).

workload: Parse an Aptio capsule whose ROM image is 8 MiB of flash with two FFS2 volumes, the layout of a small SPI BIOS region.
notes: process_rom_image slices the whole ROM into a new bytes object before MultiVolumeContainer sees it. Tracemalloc peak of that call is 8659557 bytes (7 runs, full spread 0), almost entirely the 8 MiB copy plus the two parsed volumes. The capsule already holds _data, and search_firmware_volumes accepts a memoryview, so passing a view finds the same two volumes without the copy. tests/test_capsule.py AptioCapsuleTest calls this path. The function is unchanged since 2026-10-16. Skipped the just-merged search_firmware_volumes work (#164, af70c1d), #158-#163, and the Nov 1 edits to FirmwareVolume.__init__ and the decompressor. No open PR or refactor issue covers this function.

workload: Open a $MN2 FTPR manifest whose code partition is 4 MiB, a normal CSME code-partition size.
notes: __init__ stores the partition tail with data[partition_offset:], which copies every module byte. Tracemalloc peak is 4196677 bytes for a 4 MiB tail (7 runs, full spread 0). _parse_mods already wraps self.data in a memoryview, so keeping a view of the caller's buffer leaves manifest.data equal to that tail. tests/test_me.py HuffmanLUTTest and tests/test_termination.py MeTerminationTest construct MeManifestHeader. The method is unchanged since 2026-10-16; recent me.py commits changed partition sizing and loop bounds, not this copy. Same overlap skip list: no open PRs, dexhunter only #164 (search_firmware_volumes), #158-#163, and the Nov 1 checksum/section/decompressor edits.
